newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BENPRES, FPHC IN SHARES SWAP.
newsitem.headline: BENPRES, FPHC IN SHARES SWAP.

text.p: Energy firm First Philippine Holdings Corp said on Thursday its board had approved a share swap with its parent Benpres Holdings Corp.
Under the proposed agreement, Benpres will exchange 13.8 million Manila Electric Co (Meralco) shares, or 1.7 percent of the outstanding capital stock of Meralco, with new FPHC A shares.
Benpres owns majority stake in both First Philippine Holdings and Meralco.

"Under the proposed transaction, the shares will be exchanged based on the average of the closing prices of FPHC and Meralco shares on the Philippine Stock Exchange for 20 trading days prior to the transaction date," FPHC told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
First Holdings officials were not available to explain the reason for the swap agreement.
